function: DRL joint control of BS power allocation, RIS phase shifts and time-switching factor to maximize energy-harvesting efficiency of a UAV-mounted RIS under QoS constraints (p. 3).
system: M-antenna BS, K=3 single-antenna ground users, passive reflecting RIS (N=16 elements) on a hovering UAV; air-to-ground links; carrier frequency not stated (p. 2, 4).
method: SSD3, a DRL actor-critic extending TD3 with two actors, softmax-weighted critic targets and entropy regularization; trained offline in simulation (p. 4).
data_channel: Simulated environment: air-to-ground LoS/NLoS model for BS-RIS link [8], Rician fading for RIS-user link [5], Gaussian small-angle UAV jitter; no dataset (p. 2-3).
test_conditions: Training curves from no jitter up to sigma_j=0.6; testing at sigma_j=0.1 with K=3, N=16; no unseen scenario (p. 4-5).
baselines: Learned: DDPG, SAC, TD3; non-learned: PSO, GA and exhaustive search as upper bound (p. 5).
metrics: Average EH efficiency (%) and per-step EH efficiency, cumulative reward per episode, episodes to convergence, training time in minutes (p. 5).
complexity: Order O(max(In, n^2, nO)) per inference step (p. 4); convergence times SSD3 ~129 min, TD3 ~113, DDPG ~95, PSO ~240, GA ~285, exhaustive ~660 (p. 5).
q1_support: p. 2: "We adopt an air-to-ground (ATG) channel model for BS–RIS link [8]", with Rician fading for RIS-user link; a custom simulator with no 3GPP, DeepMIMO or measured data.
q2_support: p. 5: "during testing under a jitter level of σj = 0.1"; K=3 users and N=16 elements are fixed (p. 4) and Fig. 2 shows training curves per jitter level, so no trained model is tested in a new condition.
q3_support: p. 5: "Compared to DDPG, SAC, and TD3, SSD3 consistently delivers higher performance across all time steps"; p. 5: "SSD3 not only achieves higher performance" than non-learned PSO and GA; Table I lists EH efficiency of all, with exhaustive search at 53.09%.
q4_support: p. 4: "the worst-case per-step complexity is O(max(In, n2, nO))" for the actor network of the proposed SSD3; p. 5 also gives convergence times in minutes.
q5_support: p. 4: "Simulations assume a 20 m ×20 m area with a UAV-mounted RIS comprising N = 16 elements"; the data come from the authors' own simulation, with no link, DOI, public dataset or measured data.
notes: Included: DRL (SSD3) controls BS power allocation, RIS phase shifts and time-switching ratio (action vector, p. 3). Area 6 is chosen over area 3 by the priority order, because the RIS is carried by a UAV (aerial link) and the learned action includes power control; area 3 also fits through the RIS phase shifts. The UAV hovers at a fixed position, so no trajectory is learned (not above_phy). The abstract says user powers while p. 3 says BS power allocation. SSD3 extends TD3, but DDPG and SAC are separate learned baselines. Title and DOI 10.1109/LCOMM.2025.3612448 are on p. 1.
